title: MengServerX

body:
![msx](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HuanMeng-official/MengServerX/master/readme/icon/msx.png)

> MengServerX is a feature-rich Minecraft Java Edition server plugin with multi-language support, chat formatting, AI chat, and other functionalities.  

### 🌏Support Languages:
![EN](https://img.shields.io/badge/English-100%25-blue)
![CN](https://img.shields.io/badge/简体中文-100%25-blue)
![FR](https://img.shields.io/badge/Français-100%25-blue)
![ES](https://img.shields.io/badge/Español-100%25-blue)

### 🔍Support Features:
- Multi-language support
- Modify the chat format
- Player name whitelist
- Keep Inventory
- Terrain protection
- Clean drop items
- Digging scoreboard
- Chat with AI
- Player-to-player teleportation
- Announcement of the whole server
- Command helper

### 🧩Design Concept:
This plugin adopts a modular design concept, and the various functions are not closely related to each other, which is convenient for later maintenance and update.

### 📌Special Notes:
This plugin enables the ***whitelist*** by default, if you need to turn it off, please modify the ***config.yml***, thank you for your understanding.
